text_block_list.text: One day, when I visited the front of the station...

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: Oh, I wondered who it was, but it's just you, Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: Ah, you're right. Hello~

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
I live close by.
I just came to rent a movie on DVD.

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
Well, the weather's supposed to be bad this weekend,
so I thought I'd watch it in the room with Sky-san.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: Watching a movie while lounging around and munching on snacks is the absolute best~

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
Hey! It's not like I'm trying
to slack off or anything!

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
"Movies are entertainment, but they're also
packed with meaningful messages, aren't they?"

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: "The movie I saw the other day really taught me the 'beauty of modesty'~."

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: ...Are you really learning anything?

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: What's that supposed to mean?!

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
More importantly, what movie should I rent?
I've already seen most of the new releases...

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
"If possible, I'd prefer something we can learn a lot from.
Trainer, do you have any recommendations?"
choice_data_list: Trying to build up your courage with horror movies or something?
Like learning about grand human drama from serialized TV shows?

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: "...Huh? H-Horror!?"

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
Oh, sounds good~
Having something exciting once in a while isn't so bad, right?

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
"W-Wait a minute!
I'm not interested in that kind of stuff at all...!"

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
"If you're not interested, doesn't that mean
there's even more for you to learn?"

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: Huh? Or could it be...?

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
O-ho-ho-ho!
I'm not scared at all! Not scared in the least!
And after the weekend, following our training session—

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: (*glance around...*)
choice_data_list: What is it you're so wary of?
What are you so wary of?

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
I-I'm not on guard or anything!
It's not like I'm worried a monster's gonna pop out!

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
Alright then!
Thanks for your hard work in training today!
It seemed King Halo had learned how to escape from monsters from a movie she watched over the weekend.

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: I see, learning from the way the characters lived their lives, then.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: Won't it take more than a single day to watch all that?

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
Then why don't we just split it across multiple sessions?
It looks interesting, so let's watch it.
And during training after the weekend—

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
...N-Now then...
Shall we begin training...?

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
I couldn't help myself and binged all 52 episodes...
Sky-san ended up leaving halfway through, though.

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
Even if I do say so myself,
I really want to praise how hard I worked...

Though she was supposed to learn about human drama,
King Halo ended up building her stamina instead.
